title: AGENTIF: Benchmarking Instruction Following of Large Language Models in Agentic Scenarios
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and applying a benchmark (AGENTIF) to evaluate the instruction-following capabilities of Large Language Models in agentic scenarios.
